basis: P0 plain explanations and optional fixing input-question links for all 30 sale-family member_constraints declarations on core v105, starting from sale-reasons-plain-evidence/wording.json and quoting 2025 Instructions for Form 8949 and Schedule D.

replacements.old: The wash-sale adjustment flag is affirmative but no disallowed amount is contributed. The two fields are independently contributable (ADR-0061 Decision 1), so this state is representable and must be independently blockable. Existing block code: tax.us.2025.block.f8949.box-1g-flag-without-amount.
replacements.new: This Form 1099-B sale is marked as having a box 1g wash-sale loss disallowed, but no disallowed amount was entered; enter the wash-sale loss disallowed from box 1g (or 0 if none), or unmark the box 1g wash-sale indicator.
replacements.irs_source_2025: 2025 Instructions for Schedule D, General Instructions -> Wash Sales (box 1g of Form 1099-B shows nondeductible wash sale loss and its amount).

replacements.old: A disallowed amount is contributed without an affirmative wash-sale adjustment flag. Independently blockable. Existing block code: tax.us.2025.block.f8949.box-1g-amount-without-flag.
replacements.new: A box 1g wash-sale disallowed amount was entered on this Form 1099-B sale without marking that box 1g applies; confirm whether box 1g shows a wash-sale loss disallowed, or remove the disallowed amount.
replacements.irs_source_2025: 2025 Instructions for Schedule D, General Instructions -> Wash Sales (box 1g of Form 1099-B) and Instructions for Form 8949, Column (g).

replacements.old: A positive wash-sale disallowed amount is asserted on a transaction whose proceeds are greater than or equal to its basis (code W on an individually non-loss transaction). Evaluated on this member's own proceeds and basis, never on a netted box subtotal. Existing block code: tax.us.2025.block.f8949.code-w-on-gain.
replacements.new: A wash-sale loss disallowed in box 1g of this Form 1099-B was entered on a sale that is not a loss (proceeds are at least basis); a wash sale only disallows a loss, so enter 0 in column (g) if no part of the loss is a nondeductible wash sale, or check box 1d and box 1e.
replacements.irs_source_2025: 2025 Instructions for Schedule D, General Instructions -> Wash Sales (when you sell or otherwise dispose of stock or securities at a loss) and 2025 Instructions for Form 8949, Column (f) -> Code W (enter -0- in column (g) if no part of the loss is a nondeductible wash sale loss).
replacements.fixing_question: What is the nondeductible wash-sale loss in box 1g of Form 1099-B (or the correct disallowed wash-sale loss, or 0 if none) for this long-term sale?

replacements.old: The wash-sale disallowed amount exceeds this transaction's own otherwise-deductible loss, floor_zero(basis - proceeds). Existing block code: tax.us.2025.block.f8949.adjustment-exceeds-loss.
replacements.new: The wash-sale loss disallowed in box 1g of this Form 1099-B is more than this sale's loss (its basis minus its proceeds, or zero if it is not a loss); check the box 1g amount against the proceeds in box 1d and the cost or other basis in box 1e.
replacements.irs_source_2025: 2025 Instructions for Schedule D, General Instructions -> Wash Sales (disallowed loss on a sale at a loss) and 2025 Instructions for Form 8949, Column (g) -> Code W (nondeductible wash sale loss).
